item: Ingest: furniture-line strip; menu/paywall stub signals for the quarantine job
summary: Ad-placeholder and language-specific app-banner lines are stripped in place from a newly extracted body before it is judged and hashed (other bytes untouched; off with OO_SKIP_NON_ARTICLES=0). A thin body that is digit-free menu lines or a short subscriber-prompt line is named menu_stub/paywall_stub, but only by the quarantine job and only when include_stubs is asked for (default off; restore-merge, newsletter import and the release run never use it), so the operator sees dry-run counts per signal before any mark. Nothing is dropped at ingest or deleted.
